title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 95
paragraphs: Aristides son of Lysimachos, the Athenian, of whom I made mention shortly before as a very good man, did this in the tumult around Salamis: taking with him a number of Athenian hoplites who had been stationed along the shore of Salamis, he landed with them on the island of Psyttaleia; and they killed every Persian who was on that little island.
